title: DeckView — Zoomed-Out Deck Views
description:
Shrinks cards in Slay the Spire 2 deck grid screens so more cards fit on screen at once. Hovering a card enlarges it back to full size.

Screens affected:
- Deck view
- Draw, discard, and exhaust piles
- Card library
- Deck card-selection screens

Screens left at normal size:
- Combat hand
- Card inspect popup
- Card rewards, shop, choose-a-card, unlock, and card-bundle screens

Controls:
- Click the "Mini-cards" checkbox on any affected screen, or press T, to toggle between shrunk and normal card sizes. The setting is saved between runs.
- Works with mouse, keyboard, and controller.

Visibility only: does not change cards, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay.

(The whole-act map view that older versions of DeckView included is now a separate mod: One-Page Map.)

Built for Slay the Spire 2 v0.113.1.
changeNote: 0.3.1 — Built for STS2 v0.113.1. Limits card shrinking to NCardGrid screens, handles pointer hover through a single hover controller (no flickering or stuck enlarged cards), adds the Mini-cards checkbox to draw/discard/exhaust piles and card-selection screens (hidden while peeking), and matches the checkbox size to the game's View Upgrades checkbox.
